# La Vie All Suites

> Luxury all-suites apartment at Jl. Denpasar No.18, Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan. 360 units across 2 towers (Suite Allée and Suite Porte). Developer: Wilsor Group. Architect: DP Architect Singapore. Interior: IGI Singapore.

## Property Overview
- Property Name: La Vie All Suites
- Type: Luxury All-Suites Apartment
- Location: Jl. Denpasar No.18, Karet Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan 12940
- Area: CBD Jakarta (Kuningan corridor)
- Coordinates: -6.2230, 106.8280
- Total Units: 360
- Towers: 2 (Suite Allée, Suite Porte)
- Complex Area: 9,500 sqm
- Ceiling Height: 3.2 – 3.6 m
- Year Completed: 2018
- Status: Completed, secondary market

## Developer & Design Team
- Developer: Wilsor Group
- Construction Management: PT Kajima Indonesia – Jaya CM (JO)
- Main Contractor: Total Bangun Persada
- Lead Architect: DP Architect Pte Ltd, Singapore
- Interior Designer: Ines Gerlach Interior (IGI), Singapore
- Landscape Architect: Karl Princic
- Lighting: Flaming Beacon, Australia
- Facade: Paul Adam Facade

## Unit Types

### Suite Allée Tower
| Type | Config | Private Lift | Key Features |
|------|--------|-------------|--------------|
| A & G | Studio | No | 1 Master BR, 1 Bath, Gourmet Kitchen |
| B & F | 2+1 BR | Yes | 7.5m Living Room, Dual Kitchen, Maid Area |
| D & E | 2+1 BR + Study | Yes | 7.5m Living Room, Dual Kitchen, Study |

### Suite Porte Tower
| Type | Config | Private Lift | Key Features |
|------|--------|-------------|--------------|
| A, B & F | 2 BR | No | Dual Kitchen, Spacious Living, Maid Area |
| G | 2+1 BR | No | Study Room, Dual Kitchen, Maid Area |
| D & E | 3 BR | Yes | Study, Storage, Dual Kitchen, Maid Area |

## Specifications
- Living/Dining Floor: Imported Italian Travertine by Fagetti
- Bedroom Floor: Imported timber floor
- Bathroom: High quality marble (floor and wall)
- Kitchen Appliance: Cooker, Cooker Hood & Oven by Miele
- Kitchen Top: Solid Surface
- Sanitary: Grohe, Villeroy & Boch
- Main Door: Baldwin hardware
- Bedroom Doors: Miwa
- AC: VRF system by Mitsubishi Electric
- Elevator: Mitsubishi Electric
- Electrical: Berker
